title: The Simplicity of God
definition: The simplicity of God means that God is not divided into parts. His attributes are perfectly united in who He is.
summary: God is not partly love, partly justice, partly holiness, and partly mercy as though His character were assembled from separate pieces. Everything God is, He is perfectly and fully. His love is holy, His justice is wise, His mercy is righteous, and His power is good.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the united perfection of God's character. At the cross, God's love, justice, holiness, mercy, wisdom, and grace are displayed together in perfect harmony.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is perfectly one in Himself. His attributes do not compete with each other. He is always fully holy, fully loving, fully just, fully wise, and fully good.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often separate God's attributes and imagine a god who is loving but not holy, or just but not merciful. Scripture reveals the true God whose whole character is perfectly united.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not choose one attribute of God while ignoring another. Worship Him as He reveals Himself: perfectly holy, loving, righteous, merciful, wise, and good.
